question: How can an LLM rationalize features without deleting rare essential work or merging capabilities that differ by role, scope, dependencies or evidence?
gates: No required outcome loses an executable capability
No unknown evidence becomes observed fact
Every deletion and deferral has explicit scope, reason and preservation decision
No changes to Art Direction, root entry or other domains
planned_evaluation: Paired independent task generation plus deterministic structural and mutation checks; no human usability claim
